note: Compile errors the build repairs itself, and ones it reports. 'verifiedOn' lists where the repair was seen working; a real phone is only listed when the user confirmed it.

errors.rootCause: A statement follows one that always leaves the method/loop (return/throw/break, or a try whose every path returns).
errors.repair: GENERATED_CODE_REWRITE: wrap the statement in front in if (true) { } (kept code, void contexts) or remove the dead statements (value-returning methods, or when keeping doesn't compile). Line count never changes.
errors.scope: generated sources of this build only; blocks unchanged; re-applied at every build
notVerifiedOn: any phone: v1.7.1 failed on the user's device for project #639; no log for v1.7.2+ yet

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: X cannot be resolved to a type / The import X cannot be resolved
errors.rootCause: Missing import, or the library that has the class isn't enabled for the project.
errors.repair: IMPORT_SYNTHESIS (class found on the build classpath) or DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION (enable the installed local library; download a known coordinate from Google Maven / Maven Central / JitPack; link its sub-dependencies).
verifiedOn: Android 12 ART (API 31) x86_64 (download step with network)

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: Syntax error, insert ";" / Type mismatch: cannot convert from double to int / Unreachable catch block
errors.repair: GENERATED_CODE_REWRITE: add the semicolon / add the narrowing cast / remove the catch block.

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: The method m() is undefined for the type T (typo in custom code)
errors.repair: none: reported with its origin (activity -> event/MoreBlock -> block -> line in the block's code).

errors.fingerprint: device: MainActivity.java:6379 Unreachable code, v1.7.1, project #639
errors.repair: not reproduced off-device with the reconstructed code; needs the v1.7.2+ log, which now carries the auto-fix report, the origin of each error and the build map.
